title_zh: 京张开源脉冲建设与开放就绪闸门
title_en: Open Pulse construction and opening readiness gates
author: 许丙南

required_before_design_development: official boundary, key-area polygons and ownership records
topographic, tree, pavement, accessibility and condition survey
heritage, road, rail, fire, drainage, utility and emergency-access review
geometry-versioned wind, heat, shade, air and water baseline
named operator, maintenance capability, rights record and retirement responsibility

delivery_principles.zh: 普通公共路径先成立：导视、休息、求助、无障碍和安全不依赖模型、账号、网络或电力。
delivery_principles.en: Make the ordinary public route work first: wayfinding, rest, help, access and safety cannot depend on a model, account, network or power.

delivery_principles.zh: 先轻后重：先做可逆样机和限时窗口，证据与专业复核不足时不形成永久工程。
delivery_principles.en: Move from light to heavy: begin with reversible mock-ups and time-limited windows; do not make permanent work before evidence and professional review.

delivery_principles.zh: 每个智能构件都必须能断网、断电、停用、拆除，并恢复普通公共使用。
delivery_principles.en: Every smart component must survive disconnection, power loss, shutdown and removal while ordinary public use is restored.

delivery_principles.zh: 维护、清权、投诉、备件和最终复原与设计同时进入交接包。
delivery_principles.en: Maintenance, rights, complaints, spares and final reinstatement enter the handover package together with design.

gates.entry: A bounded public problem and affected users are named; provisional geometry is not treated as an official redline.
required_outputs: versioned official or cleared base and ownership interface
survey register for topography, trees, surfaces, routes and existing assets
heritage, road, rail, drainage, utility, fire and operations constraint register
unresolved-conflict list with a no-build/no-test boundary
gates.pass_condition: Each proposed location is classified as proceed, revise or do-not-proceed by the relevant professional domain, and unknowns remain visible.
gates.stop_condition: Ownership, heritage sensitivity, emergency access, critical utility conflict or an accountable operator remains unresolved.
gates.ordinary_baseline: Paper wayfinding, staffed help and a safe accessible route remain usable without digital infrastructure.

gates.name_zh: 公共路径与被动构件样机
gates.entry: CR-01 passes for a permitted location and a reversible component is specified.
required_outputs: full-scale or representative reversible mock-up
day/night walkthrough by older, disabled, carer, visitor and maintenance users
clear-width, surface, glare, shade, drainage, edge, anchoring and removal check
snag list with geometry version and conditions not observed
gates.pass_condition: The non-AI route remains continuous, legible and maintainable; removal does not damage heritage fabric or public infrastructure.
gates.stop_condition: A trip, pinch, glare, ponding, unsafe edge, obstruction, heritage attachment or maintenance hazard is found.
gates.ordinary_baseline: The component can be dark, unpowered or removed while seating, information, assistance and drainage still function.

gates.name_en: Wind, heat, water and lifeline coordination
gates.entry: CR-02 passes and the proposed window affects a climate, drainage, utility or emergency interface.
required_outputs: geometry-versioned wind, heat, shade, air and water test brief
field plan with calibration, route coverage, missing-data treatment and professional acceptance criteria
drainage inlet/overflow, soil, utility, fire and emergency-access review
normal, degraded and exceedance-state map with a safe manual route
gates.pass_condition: The six wind-water-health gates, drainage path and life-safety interface have named reviewers, reproducible inputs and stop rules.
gates.stop_condition: Geometry is not aligned, calibration is missing, an outlet/utility conflict is unresolved, or an exceedance state has no safe route.
gates.ordinary_baseline: Passive shade, visible drainage, manual inspection and emergency access remain valid when sensors or networks fail.

gates.name_zh: 有界、有人、限时开放窗口
gates.entry: CR-01 to CR-03 pass, required permits and rights records exist, and a staffed fallback is present.
required_outputs: opening and closing time, accountable operator and public state board
visible opt-out, paper/staffed route, complaint and incident channels
embodied-intelligence stop/takeover test or passive-equivalent test
daily close-down, asset, rights and site-reinstatement checklist
gates.pass_condition: The window addresses its stated public problem without worsening safety, access, privacy, drainage, quiet, rights or ordinary service.
gates.stop_condition: A serious incident, failed takeover, blocked accessible route, unresolved complaint, unauthorized collection, rights dispute or overdue maintenance occurs.
gates.ordinary_baseline: When the window closes, residents can use the same route and service without registering or carrying a device.

gates.entry: The window reaches its end date or a stop condition triggers an early review.
required_outputs: comparison with the pre-window baseline, including negative and distributional findings
maintenance, complaint, rights, energy and material-recovery record
public retain/redesign/retire memo with accountable sign-off
data deletion, component recovery and site reinstatement record
gates.pass_condition: A reproducible decision is published; retained work enters statutory design, approval, funding and procurement processes separately.
gates.stop_condition: Evidence does not support retention, recurring responsibility is unresolved, or public harm outweighs benefit.
gates.ordinary_baseline: Retirement leaves a safe, legible, accessible and maintainable public place rather than an abandoned smart shell.

component_interfaces.name_zh: 人工求助与普通导视点
component_interfaces.name_en: Staffed help and ordinary wayfinding point
component_interfaces.non_ai_service: Readable distance, opening-state, referral and complaint information on paper or a passive board.
component_interfaces.inspection: Daily legibility and obstruction check during a window; scheduled fixing and surface review.
component_interfaces.failure_response: Cover stale content immediately and relocate/remove the object if it narrows the accessible route or lacks an owner.

component_interfaces.name_zh: 遮阴休息—雨水树池组合
component_interfaces.non_ai_service: Shade, seating, wheelchair companion space, visible inlet and overflow remain usable without sensors.
component_interfaces.inspection: Before opening and after representative rain check clear width, shade state, ponding, scour, edge and seating.
component_interfaces.failure_response: Close or bypass the bay on unsafe water, surface, heat, root, edge or maintenance conditions; do not scale from dry-weather evidence.

component_interfaces.name_zh: 可撤回具身智能停靠与急停边界
component_interfaces.name_en: Retractable embodied-AI bay and stop boundary
component_interfaces.non_ai_service: The public route stays outside the test boundary; a marshal, barrier and manual service work without autonomy.
component_interfaces.inspection: Pre-run brake, stop, barrier, communications and exclusion-zone check; log every abnormal event.
component_interfaces.failure_response: Stop on the first safety-critical failure, isolate the test, record it and prohibit restart until independent review.

component_interfaces.name_zh: 公共状态板与清权展架
component_interfaces.name_en: Public state board and rights-cleared display frame
component_interfaces.non_ai_service: Purpose, operator, data boundary, positive/negative result, appeal and withdrawal remain readable offline.
component_interfaces.inspection: Check dates, provenance, contrast, fixings, complaint channel and removal status before each open period.
component_interfaces.failure_response: Switch off or hide disputed content while preserving passive contact information; remove any object with no owner or rights basis.
